newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end flat in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end flat in cautious trade.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed flat on Monday in slow trading as early buying sentiment was tempered by late profit taking, brokers said.
Three-month CDs ended lower on the strength of buying by banks and investment trusts, while the overnight call rate closed unchanged, they said.
* 3-mth CDs end at 13.00 pct, down from 13.05 on Saturday
* Overnight call closes unchanged at 12.98 pct
The new issues were estimated at two billion won on Tuesday, compared with 122 billion won today, brokers said.
"The yields fell to 12.23 in morning trading thanks to buying by some securities houses. But profit taking followed after the central bank siphone off money in circulation," Lee of Samsung said.
